meta.description: Knowledge graph for the robosuite Lift task: a UR5e with a parallel-jaw (Robotiq85) gripper grasps a small cube on a table and lifts it above a height threshold. Consumed by the P4-LLM reasoning + decision components to ground failure analysis and the SELECT/BRIDGE demonstration choice. Coordinates are world-frame metres; the scripted expert is reliable only inside the stated cube-placement range.

properties.criterion: cube z above table by a threshold while grasped

properties.role: must center on the cube and close before lifting

properties.metric: cube height above table > threshold AND grasped

reasoning_implications.grasp_failure: Fingers close off-center or the cube slips: prescribe/select a scene where the expert demonstrates a centered, secure grasp before lifting.
reasoning_implications.approach_failure: The gripper approaches the wrong xy or height: prescribe a scene whose cube position forces a clean top-down approach onto the cube center.
reasoning_implications.contact_instability: The cube is bumped away during approach/close: emphasize a slower, aligned descent onto the cube.
reasoning_implications.timeout: Hesitation/oscillation near the cube: commit to a direct grasp-then-lift with the cube well inside the reliable range.
reasoning_implications.workspace_constraint: Every prescribed cube xy MUST stay within x[-0.03,0.03] y[-0.03,0.03] at z=0.831 (world). Out-of-range placements are unreliable and waste the round.
reasoning_implications.non_emptiness: A failure IS present, so the decision MUST cite concrete episode ids for SELECT or BRIDGE — never refuse.
